title: Managed task-sync exchange uses Git selections and object ids instead of full candidate digests, a commit SHA-256 beside the OID and separate pack hashing
outcome: Managed task-sync exchange uses Git selections and object ids instead of full candidate digests, a commit SHA-256 beside the OID and separate pack hashing
acceptance: prepare/step and the managed exchange (src/task_sync/progress.rs, directory.rs:982, exchange/delta.rs, delta/resolution.rs, work_service/task_sync_exchange/driver.rs) no longer compute full candidate digests or reread unchanged tasks; selections come from the Git diff and changed objects

src/task_sync/git/snapshot.rs no longer SHA-256s commit bytes beside the Git OID for retained selection or evidence import; pack staging/import binds integrity to the selected Git blob instead of a separate pack hash

The serialized task-membership inventory root (src/task_sync/inventory.rs) is replaced as an import/export basis by the exported and applied commit ids, unless the item records why it must stay; stored records are read as stored
Behaviour tests cover a retried exchange and an evidence-pack import on the new identity
